info.description: Production-grade RESTful API collection for TaskFlow task and project management backend.

request.description:
Delete project workspace and cascade delete all its tasks and comments (Owner or Admin).

Example Response (200 OK):
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Project and associated tasks/comments deleted successfully"
}
```
